items.title: Awesome Cl
items.content_text:
### Mobile

*   [Evergreen-Compose (⭐2)](https://github.com/atgreen/evergreen-compose) - Build native Android apps in Evergreen Common Lisp, using Jetpack Compose and Material 3. GPL-3.0-or-later WITH Classpath-exception-2.0.
    *   Evergreen Compose supplies a shared, precompiled Android runtime. Application builds require EGCL and egcl-target-android (runtime API 4), no JDK, Kotlin compiler, Gradle, Android SDK or NDK.
    *   Develop inside the running app. Connect Emacs with SLY or icl to the phone's Lisp image through an ADB-forwarded Slynk port. Evaluate Lisp, inspect application state, and update the running UI without rebuilding or reinstalling the APK

### AI-developped

*   [Evergreen (⭐21)](https://github.com/atgreen/evergreen): Evergreen is Common Lisp with a HotSpot-inspired native runtime, built from scratch in Rust. It starts executing in bytecode, compiles hot code to native instructions, and specializes dynamically typed programs as they run.
    *   new as of Oct, 2026
    *   *warning: this is an experiment. The parts that do work may not behave the way you expect, or the way the standard says they should. It may never work.*
    *   Lightweight fibers with synchronous socket I/O
    *   Native interoperability (C, JVM, Python)
    *   Standalone applications and saved images.
    *   The default x86-64 Linux build is fully static
    *   Tree shaking of Lisp and Rust
    *   Native Android applications with Slime-style development: see [evergreen-compose (⭐2)](https://github.com/atgreen/evergreen-compose)
    *   *Core code, test suites, and documentation were almost entirely generated by AI assistants following high-level human prompts and specification. Conceptual architecture, prompt direction, and repository orchestration (minimal manual code review or line-by-line verification).*

  • FluidVoice - FluidVoice is a free, GPL-3.0 macOS dictation app that transcribes on-device with very low latency and optionally cleans up text with a cloud or local model. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Formbricks - Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform — link, website, in-app and email surveys — that you can self-host with Docker or use as a cloud service. (Source (⭐13k))
  • FreeFlow - FreeFlow is an MIT-licensed Mac dictation app that transcribes and cleans up speech with Groq or any OpenAI-compatible provider you configure, with no FreeFlow server in between. (Source (⭐2.8k))
  • Grist - Grist is an Apache-licensed relational spreadsheet that combines spreadsheet formulas with database structure, self-hostable with Docker and available as a desktop app. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Handy - Handy is an MIT-licensed, fully offline dictation app for Windows, macOS and Linux that types what you say into any text field using Whisper or Parakeet on your own machine. (Source (⭐33k))
  • HeyForm - HeyForm is an AGPL-licensed, self-hostable builder for conversational forms, surveys, quizzes and polls, with logic, theming, analytics and integrations. (Source (⭐9k))
  • It's a Plan - It's a Plan is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted project management and issue tracking app where AI agents take issues on the same board as people, with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server. (Source (⭐883))
  • Jan - Jan is an Apache-2.0 desktop app that runs open LLMs offline on your own computer, with optional cloud models, custom assistants, MCP and a local OpenAI-compatible server. (Source (⭐45k))
  • Kanboard - Kanboard is an MIT-licensed Kanban project management app that focuses on simplicity, with WIP limits, automatic actions and a small PHP footprint. (Source (⭐9.9k))
  • Kaneo - Kaneo is an MIT-licensed, self-hostable project management app with boards, lists, calendars and Gantt charts, GitHub and Gitea integration, a REST API and MCP. (Source (⭐9.3k))
  • Khoj - Khoj is an AGPL-3.0 personal AI assistant that searches the web and your own documents with local or online models, self-hosted or on Khoj's cloud app. (Source (⭐38k))
  • Kinetic Life OS - Kinetic Life OS is a GPL-3.0 installable PWA that connects projects, everyday actions, health records, workouts, calendar review, and inspiration in one local-first personal workspace. (Source (⭐1))
  • Leantime - Leantime is an AGPL-3.0, self-hostable project management system that combines strategy, planning and execution, with task views, goals, timesheets and docs in one tool. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Libre WebUI - Libre WebUI is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted AI workspace with local models through Ollama, document chat, artifacts and sandboxed work environments, and no application telemetry. (Source (⭐88))
  • LibreChat - LibreChat is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI chat platform with a ChatGPT-style interface, many model providers, agents, MCP and multi-user authentication, run with Docker Compose. (Source (⭐45k))
  • LimeSurvey - LimeSurvey is a GPL-licensed, self-hostable survey platform with branching logic, multilingual surveys, response statistics, plugins and an API. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • Lotti - Private logbook for tasks, time tracking, journaling, habits and health data, with end-to-end encrypted sync and optional AI agents. (Source (⭐1.2k))
  • Minutes - Minutes is an MIT-licensed, local-first meeting and voice-memo recorder with on-device transcription, Markdown output, a CLI and an MCP server, for macOS and Windows with a CLI on Linux. (Source (⭐1.5k))
  • Morphic - Morphic is an Apache-2.0 AI search engine with generative UI that self-hosts with Docker Compose, using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama or other providers and SearxNG, Tavily, Brave or Exa for search. (Source (⭐9.2k))
  • Open Cowork - Open Cowork is an MIT-licensed desktop agent for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs that works in a folder you choose and isolates its commands in a local VM, with your own API key. (Source (⭐2.2k))
  • OpenLess - OpenLess is an AGPL-3.0 voice-typing app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android that transcribes speech and rewrites it in a chosen style, using the speech and language providers you configure. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • OpenMausBot - OpenMausBot is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Ubuntu that turns your local Claude, Codex and Grok CLIs into a roster of AI bots you chat with, each with its own computer. (Source (⭐4k))
  • OpenProject - OpenProject is a GPL-3.0 project management platform for organisations that want a self-hosted alternative to Jira and MS Project, with agile boards, Gantt planning and time tracking. (Source (⭐16k))
  • OpenWhispr - OpenWhispr is an MIT-licensed voice dictation and meeting transcription app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with on-device speech models or bring-your-own-key cloud models. (Source (⭐8.9k))
  • OpenWork - OpenWork is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs AI agents on your own files with the model of your choice. The app is MIT; a separate team control plane is under a commercial licence. (Source (⭐24k))
  • OpenWorker - OpenWorker is an MIT-licensed desktop AI coworker for macOS and Windows that works with your own model key or Ollama and asks before anything consequential. (Source (⭐18k))
  • OpnForm - OpnForm is an open-source form builder you can self-host or use as a managed cloud service, with logic, embeds, integrations, analytics and an MCP server. (Source (⭐3.8k))
  • Plane - Plane is an AGPL-3.0 project management and issue tracking platform, self-hosted as the Community Edition or used on Plane Cloud, and one of the largest open-source Linear and Jira alternatives. (Source (⭐60k))
  • Presenton - Presenton is an Apache-2.0 AI presentation generator for the web, Docker and desktop that exports editable PowerPoint files and works with local or cloud models. (Source (⭐11k))
  • Rakazo - Rakazo is an Apache-2.0 platform for running always-on AI bots with their own computers, self-hosted with Docker Compose and used from web, desktop or mobile. (Source (⭐3.3k))
  • Rome - Rome is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted environment where an AI agent turns repeated work into saved actions and installable apps, run with one Docker script. (Source (⭐689))
  • Sol - Sol is an MIT-licensed app launcher and command palette for macOS with many built-in utilities, from a window manager and clipboard history to calendar and scratchpad notes. (Source (⭐3.2k))
  • SpeakoFlow - SpeakoFlow is an MIT-licensed offline dictation app and voice assistant for Windows, macOS and Linux, with local speech recognition and a model of your choice for writing. (Source (⭐259))
  • Taiga - Taiga is an open-source agile project management tool with Scrum and Kanban, a Django backend under MPL-2.0 and an AGPL-3.0 web front end, self-hosted or hosted by its makers. (Source (⭐855))
  • Teable - Teable is a self-hostable, spreadsheet-like database built on PostgreSQL, with an AGPL Community Edition and paid AI and enterprise features unlocked by licence key. (Source (⭐22k))
  • Vane - Vane, formerly Perplexica, is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI search and answering engine that runs in one Docker container with local or cloud models and private web search. (Source (⭐37k))
  • Vicinae - Vicinae is a GPL-3.0 keyboard launcher for Linux, macOS and Windows that runs many Raycast extensions and script commands, with clipboard history, snippets and file search built in. (Source (⭐10k))
  • Vikunja - Vikunja is an AGPL-3.0 task manager you host yourself, with list, Kanban, Gantt and table views, team sharing and migration from Todoist and Trello. (Source (⭐5.5k))
  • VoiceInk - VoiceInk is a GPL-3.0 macOS dictation app that transcribes on the device and adapts its output to the app or website you are using. Official builds are paid; the source is free. (Source (⭐6.7k))
  • Voicetypr - Voicetypr is an AGPL-3.0, offline-first dictation app for Windows and macOS with local Whisper transcription, optional AI formatting and a command-line interface for agents. (Source (⭐726))
  • Voquill - Voquill is an AGPL-3.0 dictation app for macOS, Windows and Linux with local or bring-your-own-key transcription, writing styles and a synced personal dictionary. (Source (⭐1k))
  • WeKan - WeKan is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted collaborative Kanban board with a real-time interface, swimlanes, Trello import, no telemetry and translations in 234 languages. (Source (⭐21k))
  • Wox - Wox is a GPL-3.0, cross-platform keyboard launcher for Windows, macOS and Linux with a plugin store and native rendering, and describes itself as an open-source Raycast and Alfred alternative. (Source (⭐27k))

Tools

  • IOTA Watch - Read-only dashboard for IOTA Train at Home, xCoin XID / MMM and Quantus QTC, with project-specific activity, reward records and data freshness indicators. (Source (⭐0))
  • ItsPaint - Paint and screenshot-markup app for macOS, built on a UI-free Swift drawing engine that also ships as a package. (Source (⭐33))

Developer Tools

  • AgentConnect - AgentConnect is an Apache-2.0 platform for running a team of AI agents in the chat tools and code hosts your team already uses, self-hosted with Docker Compose. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • Appsmith - Appsmith is an Apache-licensed, self-hostable low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels and dashboards on top of your databases and APIs. (Source (⭐41k))
  • Appwrite - Appwrite is a BSD-3-Clause backend platform for web, mobile and AI apps, self-hosted with Docker or run on Appwrite Cloud, with SDKs for many languages. (Source (⭐58k))
  • Budibase - Budibase is a self-hostable, GPL-licensed platform for building internal apps, automations and AI agents on top of your databases and business systems. (Source (⭐28k))
  • Centaur - Centaur is a self-hosted, MIT- or Apache-licensed platform that gives a team one shared AI agent in Slack, running each conversation in an isolated Kubernetes sandbox. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • Cline - Cline is an Apache-2.0 AI coding agent that runs as a VS Code extension, a CLI and a desktop app, with human-in-the-loop approval and a choice of model providers. (Source (⭐70k))
  • Dyad - Dyad is a local AI app builder for macOS, Windows and Linux that turns prompts into working apps on your own computer with your own API keys. Apache-2.0, with Pro features under a separate licence. (Source (⭐22k))
  • Emdash - Emdash is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs AI coding agents in parallel Git worktrees, with tickets from Linear, GitHub or Jira and PR review built in. (Source (⭐5.9k))
  • Goose - Goose is an Apache-2.0 AI agent for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs on your machine, works with many model providers, and is part of the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation. (Source (⭐55k))
  • Keycloak - Keycloak is an Apache-2.0 identity and access management server and a Cloud Native Computing Foundation incubating project, self-hosted as a distribution or a container. (Source (⭐37k))
  • Kilo Code - Kilo Code is an MIT-licensed AI coding agent and autocomplete for VS Code, JetBrains and the command line, with your own keys, local models or pay-as-you-go credits at no markup. (Source (⭐27k))
  • NextCoWork - NextCoWork is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs coding agents in tabbed workspaces with an editor, terminal, Git and browser, and asks before each tool call. (Source (⭐638))
  • Oh My Android - Native macOS control panel for the Android Emulator and phones over adb, with a built-in MCP server for AI coding agents. (Source (⭐3))
  • OpenCode - OpenCode is an MIT-licensed AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with models from many providers, including local ones. (Source (⭐212k))
  • opendray - opendray is an Apache-2.0 self-hosted gateway that keeps AI coding agent sessions running on your own server and lets you reattach from a browser, a phone or chat. (Source (⭐67))
  • OpenHands - OpenHands is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted workspace for running autonomous coding agents on local or remote backends, with automations; OpenHands Cloud and Enterprise are the commercial offerings. (Source (⭐90k))
  • OpenTag - OpenTag is an MIT-licensed Slack teammate that runs your coding agent against your own checkout on a paired computer, through a self-hosted relay. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • Penpot - Penpot is an MPL-2.0 design and prototyping platform for product teams, built on open standards and self-hostable, with design tokens, an API, webhooks, plugins and an MCP server. (Source (⭐61k))
  • PocketBase - PocketBase is an MIT-licensed open-source backend in one file, with a database, realtime, auth, file storage and an admin UI, run as a standalone app or used as a Go framework. (Source (⭐61k))
  • Qwen Code - Qwen Code is an Apache-2.0 AI coding agent for the terminal that works with Qwen, other hosted models or local ones, and positions itself feature for feature against Claude Code. (Source (⭐28k))
  • Supabase - Supabase is an Apache-2.0 Postgres platform that builds the features of Firebase from open-source tools, available hosted or self-hosted with Docker Compose. (Source (⭐111k))
  • ToolJet - ToolJet is an AGPL, self-hostable platform for building internal tools, admin panels and dashboards, with a paid enterprise edition that adds AI generation and workflows. (Source (⭐41k))
  • twinny - twinny is an MIT-licensed AI coding assistant for VS Code that runs against your own model server or a gateway on your network, as a self-hosted alternative to GitHub Copilot. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • Zed - Zed is a GPL-3.0 code editor for macOS, Windows and Linux from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter, with built-in AI agents, edit prediction and multiplayer editing. (Source (⭐91k))

Business

  • aiFetchly - Open-source desktop AI agent for business automation — lead generation, knowledge library RAG, outreach, and scheduled workflows. Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux. (Source (⭐1))
  • Chatwoot - Chatwoot is an open-core omnichannel support desk — MIT outside its enterprise directory — that describes itself as an alternative to Intercom and Zendesk. (Source (⭐37k))
  • Frappe Helpdesk - Frappe Helpdesk is an AGPL-3.0 customer service and ticketing app from the makers of ERPNext, self-hosted or on Frappe Cloud. (Source (⭐3.4k))
  • FreeScout - FreeScout is an AGPL-3.0 help desk and shared mailbox that describes itself as a free self-hosted Zendesk and Help Scout alternative, with paid and free modules. (Source (⭐4.6k))
  • InvoiceFlowAI - Open-source desktop app that collects emailed invoices, extracts fields with OCR, flags uncertain results for review, and exports Excel summaries. (Source (⭐488))
  • Matomo - Matomo is a GPL-3.0 analytics platform that aims to be a free software alternative to Google Analytics, self-hosted on PHP and MySQL or run on Matomo Cloud. (Source (⭐22k))
  • OpenPanel - OpenPanel is an AGPL-3.0 analytics platform that positions itself as an open-source Mixpanel alternative and a Google Analytics replacement, with optional self-hosting. (Source (⭐7.1k))
  • Plausible Analytics - Plausible is a privacy-first web analytics tool whose self-hosted Community Edition is AGPL-3.0; some premium features stay in a proprietary directory and the paid cloud. (Source (⭐29k))
  • Rybbit - Rybbit is an AGPL-3.0 web and product analytics platform that describes itself as a privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics, self-hosted or in the cloud. (Source (⭐13k))
  • Umami - Umami is an MIT-licensed, privacy-first web analytics platform that you can self-host on Node.js and PostgreSQL or use as a hosted service. (Source (⭐39k))
  • Zammad - Zammad is an AGPL-3.0 helpdesk and ticketing system owned by the independent Zammad Foundation and developed by Zammad GmbH, self-hosted or on a hosted plan. (Source (⭐6k))

Media

  • Buzz - Buzz is an MIT-licensed offline transcription app for macOS, Windows and Linux, powered by OpenAI's Whisper and running entirely on your computer. (Source (⭐22k))
  • ComfyUI - ComfyUI is a GPL-3.0 node-based interface and engine for running diffusion and other generative models locally, on Windows, macOS and Linux. (Source (⭐136k))
  • Invoke - Invoke (formerly InvokeAI) is an Apache-2.0 application for generating and editing images with Stable Diffusion, Flux and other open models on your own GPU. (Source (⭐28k))
  • SwarmUI - SwarmUI (formerly StableSwarmUI) is an MIT-licensed web interface for generating images and video with open models locally, using ComfyUI as its backend. (Source (⭐4.6k))
  • Vibe - Vibe is an MIT-licensed offline transcription app for macOS, Windows and Linux that keeps audio on your device and exports to SRT, VTT, TXT, PDF, DOCX and more. (Source (⭐7.6k))
  • VoiceStudio - VoiceStudio is an AGPL-3.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that does voice cloning, dubbing, dictation and audiobook production locally. Its default model's weights are licensed for non-commercial use only. (Source (⭐53k))

items.title: Awesome Dataviz
items.content_text:
### JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

*   [Apache ECharts (⭐67k)](https://github.com/apache/echarts) - Highly customizable and interactive charts ready for big datasets.
*   [billboard.js (⭐6k)](https://github.com/naver/billboard.js) - Reusable D3.js-based chart library with SVG and Canvas rendering, maintained by NAVER.
*   [C3.js (⭐9.3k)](https://github.com/c3js/c3) - D3-based reusable chart library.
*   [Cal-Heatmap (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/wa0x6e/cal-heatmap) - Time-series calendar heatmaps, similar to GitHub's contribution graph, built on D3.
*   [Carbon Charts (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-charts) - Chart library from IBM's Carbon Design System, built on D3, with React, Angular, Vue and Svelte wrappers.
*   [chart.xkcd (⭐7.9k)](https://github.com/timqian/chart.xkcd) - Chart library that renders line, bar, pie and other charts in a hand-drawn xkcd style.
*   [ChartGPU (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/ChartGPU/ChartGPU) - WebGPU charting library for large datasets, real-time streaming and multi-chart dashboards.
*   [Charts.css (⭐6.6k)](https://github.com/ChartsCSS/charts.css) - CSS framework that styles HTML tables as charts.
*   [DHTMLX Gantt (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/DHTMLX/gantt) - Gantt chart component for project schedules, with task dependencies and drag-and-drop editing.
*   [ECharts GL (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/ecomfe/echarts-gl) - Extension for Apache ECharts that adds 3D plots, globe visualizations and WebGL-accelerated series.
*   [Flot (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/flot/flot) - jQuery plotting library for line, bar and pie charts with zooming and other interactive features.
*   [Frappe Charts (⭐15k)](https://github.com/frappe/charts) - Simple, responsive SVG charts with zero dependencies.
*   [Frappe Gantt (⭐6.1k)](https://github.com/frappe/gantt) - Simple, interactive SVG Gantt chart library.
*   [G2 (⭐13k)](https://github.com/antvis/G2) - An interactive and responsive charting library based on the grammar of graphics, maintained by Alibaba.
*   [heatmap.js (⭐6.4k)](https://github.com/pa7/heatmap.js) - Canvas-based library for rendering heatmaps, with plugins for Leaflet and Google Maps.
*   [roughViz (⭐7.2k)](https://github.com/jwilber/roughViz) - Sketchy, hand-drawn style charts for the browser, based on Rough.js.
*   [TOAST UI Chart (⭐5.4k)](https://github.com/nhn/tui.chart) - Complete library with support for legacy browsers.
*   [Unovis (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/f5/unovis) - Modular data visualization framework for React, Angular, Svelte, Vue and vanilla TypeScript, by F5.
*   [uPlot (⭐11k)](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) - Small, fast canvas-based charts for time series, lines, areas, OHLC and bars.
*   [VChart (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/VisActor/VChart) - Cross-platform charting library with animation and storytelling features, from ByteDance's VisActor.

### JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

*   [3d-force-graph (⭐6.4k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph) - 3D force-directed graph component using Three.js/WebGL.
*   [cosmos.gl (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/cosmosgl/graph) - GPU-accelerated force graph layout and rendering engine that runs entirely in WebGL shaders.
*   [dagre (⭐5.8k)](https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre) - Directed graph layout library for JavaScript.
*   [elkjs (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs) - Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) graph layout algorithms for JavaScript.
*   [force-graph (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph) - Force-directed graph component rendered on HTML5 canvas.
*   [JointJS (⭐5.4k)](https://github.com/clientIO/joint) - SVG-based JavaScript diagramming library for interactive diagrams and graph editors.
*   [Viz.js (⭐4.3k)](https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js) - Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly for rendering DOT graphs in the browser and Node.js.
*   [Vue Flow (⭐6.9k)](https://github.com/bcakmakoglu/vue-flow) - Flowchart and node-based graph component for Vue 3.
*   [X6 (⭐6.7k)](https://github.com/antvis/X6) - Diagramming library for DAGs, ER diagrams, flowcharts and other graph editors, maintained by Alibaba.
*   [xyflow (⭐39k)](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow) - React Flow and Svelte Flow: libraries for building node-based editors, flow charts and interactive diagrams.

### JavaScript tools / Financial charts

*   [chartjs-chart-financial (⭐809)](https://github.com/chartjs/chartjs-chart-financial) - Chart.js module that adds candlestick and OHLC chart types.
*   [HQChart (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/jones2000/HQChart) - K-line and stock charts with a technical indicator scripting engine, for web pages and WeChat mini programs.
*   [KLineChart (⭐4.2k)](https://github.com/klinecharts/KLineChart) - Lightweight, highly customizable candlestick (k-line) chart with zero dependencies and mobile support.
*   [Lightweight Charts (⭐17k)](https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts) - Performant HTML5 canvas financial charts, from TradingView.
*   [React Financial Charts (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/react-financial/react-financial-charts) - React components for financial charts: candlesticks, technical indicators, overlays and drawing tools.
*   [TradeCanvas (⭐22)](https://github.com/bonguynvan/tradecanvas) - Financial charts with indicators, drawing tools and live feeds, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL.
*   [Vela (⭐992)](https://github.com/LuxAlgo/Vela) - Financial charting library with a headless core, native WebGL2 renderer and plugin SDK, from LuxAlgo.

### JavaScript tools / Maps

*   [Cesium (⭐16k)](https://github.com/CesiumGS/cesium) - WebGL 3D globes and maps.
*   [COBE (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/shuding/cobe) - Lightweight WebGL globe library of about 5 kB, with configurable markers.
*   [globe.gl (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl) - UI component for globe data visualization using Three.js/WebGL.
*   [mapcn (⭐12k)](https://github.com/AnmolSaini16/mapcn) - Map components for React built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind and compatible with shadcn/ui.
*   [MapLibre GL JS (⭐12k)](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js) - WebGL-based interactive vector tile maps in the browser; community fork of Mapbox GL JS.
*   [maptalks.js (⭐4.5k)](https://github.com/maptalks/maptalks.js) - Pluggable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
*   [OpenLayers (⭐13k)](https://github.com/openlayers/openlayers) - Library for interactive web maps with support for many data sources, formats and projections.
*   [Potree (⭐5.6k)](https://github.com/potree/potree) - WebGL point cloud viewer for large datasets such as LiDAR scans.
*   [React Simple Maps (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/zcreativelabs/react-simple-maps) - Composable SVG map charts for React, based on d3-geo and TopoJSON.
*   [react-map-gl (⭐8.5k)](https://github.com/visgl/react-map-gl) - React components for MapLibre GL JS and Mapbox GL JS, maintained by vis.gl.
*   [TerriaJS (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/TerriaJS/terriajs) - Library for building web-based 2D and 3D geospatial data explorers with catalogs of map layers.

### JavaScript tools / d3

*   [D3.js (⭐114k)](https://github.com/d3/d3) - JavaScript library for producing dynamic, data-driven visualizations with SVG, Canvas and HTML.

### JavaScript tools / React

*   [Ant Design Charts (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design-charts) - React chart library based on AntV, with statistical charts, graphs and maps.
*   [echarts-for-react (⭐5k)](https://github.com/hustcc/echarts-for-react) - React wrapper for Apache ECharts.
*   [MUI X Charts (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/mui/mui-x/tree/master/packages/x-charts) - React chart components from MUI; the community package is MIT-licensed.
*   [react-chartjs-2 (⭐6.9k)](https://github.com/reactchartjs/react-chartjs-2) - React components for Chart.js.
*   [react-force-graph (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/react-force-graph) - React components for 2D, 3D, VR and AR force-directed graphs.
*   [react-plotly.js (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/plotly/react-plotly.js) - React component for Plotly.js charts, maintained by Plotly.
*   [Semiotic (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic) - React data visualization library for charts, network graphs and streaming data.
*   [Tremor (⭐16k)](https://github.com/tremorlabs/tremor-npm) - React components for building charts and dashboards, based on Recharts and Tailwind CSS.
*   [visx (⭐21k)](https://github.com/airbnb/visx) - Low-level visualization components that combine D3 with React, by Airbnb.

### JavaScript tools / React Native

*   [React Native Chart Kit (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/chart-kit/react-native-chart-kit) - Line, bar, pie, progress and contribution graph charts for React Native.

  • Plotly.rs (⭐1.5k) - Plotly.js-based interactive plotting library for Rust.

Markup-based tools / Misc

  • C4-PlantUML (⭐7.4k) - PlantUML macros and styles for drawing software architecture diagrams with the C4 model.
  • CeTZ (⭐1.9k) - Drawing library for Typst with a TikZ-inspired API, for diagrams and plots.
  • D2 (⭐26k) - Declarative diagram scripting language that turns text into diagrams.
  • Diagrams (⭐43k) - Diagram as code in Python for prototyping cloud system architectures.
  • Flowchart Fun (⭐3.4k) - Web app that generates flowcharts and diagrams from indented text.
  • flowchart.js (⭐8.7k) - Draws SVG flowcharts from a textual description.
  • Kroki (⭐4.4k) - Unified API that renders diagrams from many text formats, including PlantUML, Mermaid, Graphviz and D2.
  • LikeC4 (⭐5.8k) - Architecture-as-code language and tools that generate live, interactive diagrams.
  • Markmap (⭐13k) - Builds interactive mind maps from Markdown.
  • Mermaid (⭐91k) - Generate diagrams and flowcharts from markdown-like text definitions, with a live editor.
  • nomnoml (⭐2.8k) - Draws UML diagrams from a simple text syntax.
  • Penrose (⭐8k) - Creates diagrams from mathematical notation in plain text, from Carnegie Mellon University.
  • PGF/TikZ (⭐1.4k) - TeX packages for programmatically drawing vector graphics and diagrams in LaTeX.
  • PGFPlots (⭐257) - TeX package for drawing 2D and 3D plots directly in LaTeX documents.
  • PlantUML (⭐13k) - Generates UML, Gantt, mind map and other diagrams from plain text.
  • Svgbob (⭐4.2k) - Converts ASCII art diagrams into SVG.
  • WaveDrom - Draws timing diagrams and waveforms from simple textual descriptions.

Other tools / Misc

  • Cytoscape (⭐731) - Desktop platform for network analysis and visualization, widely used in bioinformatics.
  • Data Formulator (⭐18k) - AI-assisted tool for transforming data and creating visualizations, from Microsoft Research.
  • draw.io (⭐8.5k) - Client-side JavaScript editor for flowcharts, network, UML and other diagrams.
  • ERD Lab - Free cloud based entity relationship diagram (ERD) tool made for developers.
  • FlameGraph (⭐20k) - Stack trace visualizer that generates interactive SVG flame graphs from profiling data.
  • GeoLibre (⭐7.8k) - Cloud-native GIS app for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data on the web, desktop and mobile.
  • GMT (⭐983) - Command-line tools for processing geographic data and making publication-quality maps and plots.
  • gnuplot - Command-line driven program for 2D and 3D plots, with many output formats.
  • Gource (⭐13k) - Animated visualization of software version control history.
  • LabPlot (⭐486) - KDE application for interactive scientific plotting, data analysis and visualization.
  • mcp-server-chart (⭐4.4k) - MCP server from AntV that lets AI agents generate more than 25 chart types.
  • Orange (⭐5.7k) - Visual programming tool for data mining, machine learning and interactive data visualization.
  • QGIS (⭐14k) - Desktop geographic information system for viewing, editing, analyzing and mapping geospatial data.
  • Sampler (⭐15k) - Terminal dashboard that runs shell commands and visualizes their output, configured with YAML.
  • SandDance (⭐7.1k) - Visual data exploration and presentation with animated unit visualizations, from Microsoft Research.
  • sankeydiagram.net - Web app for creating and sharing Sankey diagrams of flows and budgets without code.
  • SankeyMATIC (⭐1.4k) - Web tool for building Sankey diagrams from a plain-text description of flows.
  • sqliteviz (⭐2.4k) - Browser app that loads CSV, JSON or SQLite files, runs SQL and charts the results offline.
  • ttyplot (⭐1.4k) - Real-time terminal plotting utility that reads data from standard input.
  • uMap (⭐1.6k) - Web app for creating maps with OpenStreetMap layers and embedding them in websites.
  • VisiData (⭐9.3k) - Terminal spreadsheet multitool for exploring and arranging tabular data, with basic plotting.

Websites / Misc

  • VivaMap - Interactive quality-of-life map of Swiss and Dutch municipalities, scored on an H3 hexagon grid.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [Supercov (⭐145)](https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov) - Coverage, security and code quality for coding agents. Gemini CLI extension that runs the project's existing tests, measures line, branch and MC/DC coverage, and hands Gemini the untested code to test next. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Awakado](https://awakado.noodledragon.studio) - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.

### API Bridges & Proxies

*   [cliproxy-rs (⭐16)](https://github.com/vayungodara/cliproxy-rs) - Rust rewrite of CLIProxyAPI with a built-in dashboard. Serves the Gemini API on a local endpoint (`GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL`), so Gemini CLI can run on Gemini API keys or on signed-in Claude and ChatGPT accounts.

### MCP Servers

*   [Connections (⭐1)](https://github.com/Lunarwerx/connections-gemini-extension) - Work a free Connections contact book, follow-ups, ticketed event pages, notes and email from Gemini CLI; no card needed for the account. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth sign-in at `https://studio.connections.icu/v1/mcp`. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Lunarwerx/connections-gemini-extension`.
*   [LinkMCP](https://app.linkmcp.io) - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp`.
